# Fidel API

Fidel API provides a developer-friendly, secure, and reliable API for businesses to link payment cards with mobile and web applications, enabling real-time transaction monitoring and event-based experiences.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/fidel-api/.

## Actions

- **Create Brand**: Create a new brand on fidel.
- **Create Program**: Create a new program.
- **Create Program Webhook**: Register a new webhook for program-related events.
- **Delete Offer**: Delete a specified offer by its id.
- **Delete Program Webhook**: Delete a specified webhook for a program.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a specified webhook.
- **Get Brand** (read-only): Retrieve information about a specific brand.
- **Get Offer** (read-only): Fetch details of a specific offer.
- **Get Program** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific program.
- **Get Webhook** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific webhook.
- **List Brands** (read-only): List all brands.
- **List Cards** (read-only): List all cards for a specific program.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List all locations for a program.
- **List Offers** (read-only): List all offers.
- **List Program Webhooks** (read-only): List all registered webhooks for a specific program.
- **List Programs** (read-only): List fidel programs.
- **List Transactions** (read-only): List transactions.
- **Update Program**: Update a program's name, icon, metadata, or status.
